sessionTitle: Scale enterprise .NET apps with AI‑assisted cross‑platform workflows

announcements.name: Uno Platform Studio 3.0
announcements.shortDescription: The evolution of Uno's AI and design tooling into an agentic workflow with skills, plugins, MCP tools, previews, and snippets.
announcements.longDescription: Uno Platform Studio 3.0 is presented as the evolution of Uno's AI and design tooling into an agentic workflow with skills, plugins, MCP tools, previews, and snippets. It includes a specialized agent that knows how to build Uno Platform apps, backed by 60+ skills and MCP tools so agents can look at docs and validate the UI in efficient agentic loops. To remove cross-platform .NET setup barriers (iOS, Android, Windows, Mac SDKs), it ships as the zero-install Uno Platform Studio app that runs on desktop, web, and mobile, spinning up a full .NET app in the browser with visual UI editing and export to an IDE or CLI.

announcements.name: Specialized Uno Platform agent backed by 60+ skills
announcements.shortDescription: A purpose-built agent, grounded by skills and MCP tools, that knows how to build Uno Platform apps and validate UI in a loop; skills cover areas like navigation and Material toolkit theming.
announcements.longDescription: A purpose-built Uno Platform agent grounded by documentation search/fetch and MCP-based app interactivity tools (click, screenshot) so it can work in a loop until the UI is correct. The same MCP tools work across the Uno IDE flow and GitHub Copilot inside Visual Studio, VS Code, or other editors. The agent is backed by 60+ skills released as of that day for areas like navigation and Material toolkit theming, helping the agent do the right thing as part of the Uno Platform Studio 3.0 push.

announcements.name: Uno Platform Studio browser app
announcements.shortDescription: A zero-install app running on desktop, web, and mobile that spins up a full cross-platform .NET app from a prompt, with visual editing and export to an IDE, GitHub, or local environment.
announcements.longDescription: The Uno Platform Studio app is a zero-install application that runs seamlessly on desktop, web, and mobile, removing the cross-platform .NET setup barrier of depending on iOS, Android, Windows, and Mac SDKs. From the browser at platform.uno, a user types a prompt (e.g., "build a weather app") and an agent spins up a full cross-platform .NET app, visually building it so the UI can be tweaked. Once happy, the user exports and drops down into their IDE or CLI for a full cross-platform .NET experience. It is positioned against tools like Lovable and Bolt but produces a real .NET cross-platform app rather than vibe coding.

announcements.name: Previews shipping in 3.0
announcements.shortDescription: Build and validate UI components in isolation across responsive breakpoints, data context states, and themes.
announcements.longDescription: As part of Uno Platform 3.0's key building blocks, previews let developers build, preview, and validate UI components in isolation across responsive boundaries, data context states, and themes. They complement the specialized agent with skills and MCP tools, plus snippets and hot design/hot reload, where changes made anywhere across the console or GUI are reflected immediately.

announcements.name: Skills and plugins for external agents
announcements.shortDescription: Usable from GitHub Copilot, Codex, and Claude Code, so any agent can be grounded in Uno best practices.
announcements.longDescription: Uno Platform 3.0 ships skills and plugins that can be used from external agents including GitHub Copilot, Codex, and Claude Code [inferred], so any agent can be grounded in Uno best practices. The tooling is powered by MCP, allowing developers to call their own MCP servers or external services, and is model-agnostic—the demo used GPT-5 mini but any model can be chosen. The intent is to let developers start anywhere and lower the barrier to entry.
